can_choose_theologian_for_duel_tt.en: The debate will be in #Y 1 Year#! and we have to choose a [character|e] to represent us in the debate.\n#Y The [ruler|e] of the losing side has to convert to the [religion|e] of the winning party.#!\nUnlock the [ShowCharacterInteractionName('choose_theologian_duelist')] character interaction
can_choose_theologian_for_duel_tt.uk: Диспут відбудеться за #Y 1 рік#!, і ми маємо обрати [Concept('character','персонажа')|e], який представлятиме нас.\n#Y [Concept('ruler','Правитель')|e] сторони, що програла, мусить прийняти [Concept('religion','віру')|e] переможців.#!\nВідкриває взаємодію [ShowCharacterInteractionName('choose_theologian_duelist')]

flavor_swe_nov.1.a.en: [swedish_theologian.GetSheHe|U] shall be welcomed in our humble realm!

flavor_swe_nov.1.a.entry.en: He shall be welcomed in our humble realm!

flavor_swe_nov.1.desc.en: A religious man from [sweden_country.GetName] made a long journey. At the order of [swedish_theologian.GetHerHis] majesty, [swedish_theologian.GetName] traveled to the distant lands of [byzantium_country.GetName] for a Theological Debate, which shall show the superiority of the Roman Catholic Church over Orthodoxy.\n\nHowever, the [byzantium_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] have proven themselves as rather convincing, and the holy ambassador converted to [byzantium_country.GetReligion.GetName]. Naturally, the foolish [sweden_country.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] could not accept a prominent heretic in [sweden_country.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetHerHis] court and expelled [swedish_theologian.GetNameWithNoTooltip]. Now [swedish_theologian.GetSheHe] has come to us to find a new home amongst [swedish_theologian.GetHerHis] new brothers and sisters in faith.

flavor_swe_nov.10.a.nov.en: [novgorod_country.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName] as well as #R 10.0%#! of the population in [novgorod_country.GetCapital.GetName] will change their religion to [sweden_country.GetReligion.GetName].

flavor_swe_nov.10.a.swe.en: [sweden_country.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName] as well as #R 10.0%#! of the population in [sweden_country.GetCapital.GetName] will change their religion to [novgorod_country.GetReligion.GetName].

flavor_swe_nov.10.desc.en: Our theologian won the debate! This confirms that our confession is the one true of Christ!

flavor_swe_nov.10.desc.auto_win.en: The infidels failed to participate in the debate! This confirms that our confession is the one true of Christ!

flavor_swe_nov.11.desc.en: Our theologian lost the debate. This has discredited our confession in comparison with that of the rival theologian...

flavor_swe_nov.11.desc.no_participicatio.en: We have failed to participate in the debate. This has discredited our confession in comparison with that of the rival theologian...

flavor_swe_nov.2.a.entry.en: Persuade $NOV$ to convert to our faith.

flavor_swe_nov.2.a.tt.en: We will challenge the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] of [novgorod_country.GetName] to a #Y Theological Debate#!! This debate will decide the religious future of our states

flavor_swe_nov.2.desc.en: The growing tension of the past years between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and [novgorod_country.GetName] is not being restricted only to border conflicts, but also to the religious issue, as the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] of each country considers the other to be schismatic. This topic has come to the mind of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName], which has decided to promote a risky offer for [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip]: Hold a theological debate to determine which confession is right on its dogma, the loser country having to convert to the other.\n\nSome of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetHerHis] advisors think that this is a wonderful idea, while others are more cautious about this approach to our relationship with [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_swe_nov.2.entry.en: Sweden Country Demands of Novgorod Country Conversion

flavor_swe_nov.3.c.tt.en: We will accept the #Y Theological Debate#! against [sweden_country.GetName]

flavor_swe_nov.3.desc.en: The [sweden_country.GetAdjective] have come with a questionable demand: They want to hold a theological debate between [swedish_theologian.GetName] and one of our theologians, to determine which of our confessions is right, the loser country having to convert to the other.\n\nThis demand is creating a heated debate among our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')], with a diversity of opinions about how to respond to them.

flavor_swe_nov.3.tt.en: #R This might anger [sweden_country.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName] of [sweden_country.GetName], resulting potentially in a war between our states.#!

flavor_swe_nov.4.b.tt.en: [swedish_theologian.GetName] and other theologians will travel to [target_location.GetName] for a religious debate with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] of [byzantium_country.GetName]

flavor_swe_nov.4.desc.en: [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] has dodged the proposed theological debate, forwarding us to send [swedish_theologian.GetName] to [target_location.GetName], to debate with the [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] theologians, renowned for their intricate religious reasoning after centuries of ongoing debates about which beliefs are [ShowReligionName('orthodox')] and which are Heretic.

flavor_swe_nov.4.desc.no_byz.en: [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] has dodged the proposed theological debate and insulted our honor!

flavor_swe_nov.5.a.at.en: [swedish_theologian.GetName] accepts [swedish_theologian.GetHerHis] defeat in the debate, and converts to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetName].\n[swedish_theologian.GetSheHe|U] returns to [sweden_country.GetName] to preach for our faith.

flavor_swe_nov.5.desc.en: An interesting character has appeared at our court. [swedish_theologian.GetName] is a [sweden_country.GetAdjective] theologian forwarded to us by [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] to debate about which is the one true confession of Christ, as per the renowned expertise of [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjective] theologians in these matters of faith.

flavor_swe_nov.6.desc.en: [swedish_theologian.GetName] has returned to our country after debating with the [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjective] theologians, as he was forwarded to them by the [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip]. This has not resulted in how [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName] envisioned, as [swedish_theologian.GetNameWithNoTooltip] now defends that the confession practiced in [target_location.GetName] is the one true of Christ.

flavor_swe_nov.7.a.tt.en: We will accept the #Y Theological Debate#! against [novgorod_country.GetName]

flavor_swe_nov.7.desc.en: [swedish_theologian.GetName] has returned to our country with great news: [novgorod_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] accepts to hold a theological debate with him!

flavor_swe_nov.8.a.en: May the better Theological Debater win!

flavor_swe_nov.8.a.tt.en: [novgorodian_theologian.GetName] and [swedish_theologian.GetName] will hold a #Y 3 days#! long #Y Theological Debate#!

flavor_swe_nov.8.b.en: O Lord, thou hast our eternal gratitude for this victory!

flavor_swe_nov.8.b.tt.en: The debate results in a victory for [sweden_country.GetName]

flavor_swe_nov.8.c.tt.en: The debate results in a victory for [novgorod_country.GetName]

flavor_swe_nov.8.desc.en: A debate is going to be held between [swedish_theologian.GetName] and a [novgorod_country.GetAdjective] theologian. Of their theological understanding and reasoning will depend to prove which is the one true confessions of Christ.

flavor_swe_nov.8.desc.nov_is_dead.en: The state of [GetCountry('NOV').GetName] has been vanquished from the face of the world! Whatever Theological Debate we hoped to have; whatever attempt to strengthen the influence of the Lord has found a premature end.

flavor_swe_nov.8.desc.unprepared_both.en: It might be fate. It might be even the Will of the Lord.\n\nThe unimaginable has happened: both parties failed to propose a representative for their beliefs! The Debate has failed before it had any chance to start.

flavor_swe_nov.8.desc.unprepared_nov.en: The Lord is with us! The infidels of [novgorod_country.GetName] failed to appoint a representative for their heresy. As such, the debate is a clear victory for the [sweden_country.GetReligion.GetAdjective] faith!

flavor_swe_nov.8.desc.unprepared_swe.en: Neglect; Death; The Hands of the Devil - there are many reasons why our state has failed to appoint a representative for the [sweden_country.GetReligion.GetAdjective] cause. The fact is the infidels of [novgorod_country.GetAdjective] have sent their best theologian while we could not even present them with a sack of wheat.\n\nMay the Lord forgive us.

flavor_swe_nov.8.e.en: Not the victory we have envisioned, but a victory nonetheless!

flavor_swe_nov.9.a.tt.en: The #Y Theological Debate#! will be concluded in #Y 3 days#!.\n[sweden_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Theologian Skills: [swedish_theologian.GetTotalAbility]\n[novgorod_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Theologian Skills: [novgorodian_theologian.GetTotalAbility]

flavor_swe_nov.9.desc.en: The debate between [swedish_theologian.GetName] and the [novgorod_country.GetAdjective] theologian has concluded. It will have consequences on each of the countries' confession.
